note: ref is the git ref where path exists. pending true means that ref is an open draft branch and default_branch does not contain path yet. After the pull request merges, Lead re-saves from default_branch. Grok Bot copies never write back. When pending is false and pending_pr is set, path is already on default_branch and that open draft changes the file: re-save from default_branch for the standing copy, and from the draft branch only to try the unmerged text.

skills.name: ultrathink-protocol
skills.purpose: Plans non-trivial work inside the conversation before a multi-step build, fix, or refactor, including when /ultrathink-protocol is invoked.

skills.name: ultrathink-plan
skills.purpose: Runs the native ultrathink planner and answers each pending model request until the plan validates.

skills.name: ultrathink-kickoff
skills.purpose: After Ming approves a native plan, creates Linear and Notion rows from the dry-run payloads and records the real refs.

skills.name: ultrathink-sync
skills.purpose: Updates an existing Linear issue and Notion rows by Graph ID after a PR opens. Never creates rows.

skills.name: ultrathink-ship
skills.purpose: Runs the review-only Greptile loop on a tracked PR, cap 5, then asks Ming to merge. Never merges.

skills.name: ultrathink-off
skills.purpose: Remembers that planning stays off for this conversation until /ultrathink-on.

skills.name: ultrathink-on
skills.purpose: Remembers that planning is on again for this conversation.

skills.name: ultrathink-quick
skills.purpose: Answers one message without planning or tracker rows.

skills.name: ultrathink-skip
skills.purpose: Skips planning for the next message in this conversation only.

skills.name: ultrathink-status
skills.purpose: Reports only the planning preferences this conversation remembers.

skills.name: ultrathink-track
skills.purpose: Remembers whether tracker rows are wanted; planning continues either way.

skills.name: swarm-cloud-dispatch
skills.purpose: Lead hands a repository to a keyless Cursor cloud agent that runs the 15 AgentSwarm agents as subagents and returns a draft pull request.

skills.name: desk-shared-memory
skills.purpose: Calls the seat gateway for brief, recall, retain, docs, events, ownership, receipts and doctor. Memory is reached only through that gateway.

skills.name: desk-run
skills.purpose: One /desk-run or /ultrathink command: native planning, gateway memory, pstack beside GSD commands, then a keyless cloud draft PR and the review-only Greptile gate.
